title: Denef-Loeser zeta functions of suspensions and Lê-Yomdin singularities
summary: The holomorphy conjecture for suspensions of plane curve singularities and the holomorphy and monodromy conjectures for Lê-Yomdin singularities of surfaces are proved. The first part of this paper provides formulæ for the motivic and topological zeta functions for a family of hypersurfaces, including the suspensions by an arbitrary number of points and which are more general than Thom-Sebastiani type.
